content.text: I'll plan the lighthouse first, then build it in stages.
Rocky base: dark grey 8x8, three rough courses.
Lower tower: 6×6 ring in red/white bands, then a ledge plate.
Upper tower: 4×4 ring, ten courses of red/white bands.

content.text: Gallery balcony, trans-clear lantern room, and black roof.
Trimming the auto-tie plates that strayed outside the 10×10 footprint.
The base courses never interlocked — adding a dark-grey plate belt around the base top to tie them into one piece.
